title: Loaded Potato with {p} & {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C), scrub the {s}, prick with a fork and bake 45 to 60 minutes, until soft.
Meanwhile cook the {p} with the {spice} until {doneness}, scrambling any eggs until fully set, then keep on a clean plate.
Sauté or steam the {v} until tender.
Split the {s}, fluff the insides and pile on the {p}, the {v} and the {sauce}.
tip: Beans and plenty of veg on top, and a spoonful of yogurt in place of sour cream, make it a balanced meal.
